card.name: Unit word right before a slash
card.fires_on: The word or letter just before a slash that starts the second half of a unit, such as cells before /μL, w or v before /v, and L before /minute. It appears after a number in lab thresholds and concentrations.

modes.label: Cell counts
modes.description: The word cells after a count threshold, right before /μL.

modes.label: Percent w/v or v/v
modes.description: The letter w or v after a percent, before /v.

modes.label: Rate units
modes.description: The unit letter before /minute after a number.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of common slash-unit endings such as /k, /cm and /a, and raises unrelated markers.
card.plain: It fires on the unit word just before a slash, as in cells/μL or w/v.
